statement.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
statement.summary: The Fed held the federal funds rate at 3.75%-4% by a 10-2 vote. It said inflation remains elevated, more information will guide the appropriate stance, and the Committee will deliver price stability. Two members wanted a quarter-point hike.
statement.quote: The accumulation of more information will help the Committee determine the policy stance appropriate to ensure a timely return of inflation to the Committee's 2 percent goal.
statement.vote: 10-2; Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack preferred to raise the target range by 1/4 percentage point

statement.title: Monetary policy decisions
statement.summary: The ECB held its three key rates unchanged, with the deposit rate at 2.50%. Rising energy prices threaten higher inflation and weaker growth. Policy stays data-dependent, meeting by meeting, with no pre-commitment to a particular rate path.
statement.quote: The Governing Council is not pre-committing to a particular rate path.

statement.title: Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
statement.summary: The Bank of England raised Bank Rate 0.25 points to 4% on energy-driven inflation risks, with CPI expected near 5% by mid-2027. Policy is not on a pre-set path; decisions depend on meeting-by-meeting evidence of knock-on effects.

statement.title: Bank of Canada raises the policy rate by 25 basis points to 2½%
